minVcpu.description: Minimum positive vCPU count requested by the workload.

minMemoryGb.description: Minimum positive memory in GiB requested by the workload.

minDiskGb.description: Minimum boot disk size in GiB requested by the workload. Zero is allowed.

exclusiveNode.description: Whether the workload requests exclusive use of its node.

vmSize.description: Deprecated legacy size hint. Prefer resourceRequirements; SAM compatibility policy translates old tiers.

sourceType.description: Trigger source. Cron fields are null for event-driven sources.

vmSizeOverride.description: Deprecated legacy size hint. Prefer resourceRequirementsJson/resourceRequirements on write paths.

resourceRequirementsJson.description: Persisted modern workload requirements JSON for trigger compatibility.

path.description: Dot-separated path in the JSON request body.

tokenLastFour.description: Only the final four token characters; never credential material.

vmSizeOverride.description: Deprecated legacy size hint. Prefer modern workload requirements on profiles/skills.

resourceRequirementsJson.description: Persisted modern workload requirements JSON for profile compatibility.

vmSize.description: Legacy compatibility size label; may not identify provider-native hardware.

providerInstanceMemoryMb.description: Provider-native memory in MiB when known.

providerInstanceDiskGb.description: Provider-native disk size in GiB when known.
